summary_note: This tracker loads the latest repo snapshot. The button below checks GitHub for a newer snapshot at most once per day in this browser; official pricing pages can still change between repo refreshes.
history_note: History lines use official pricing snapshots that are stored in this repo. Some providers only have one official snapshot recorded so far, while others mix successive flagship or promo models.

api_pricing.notes: Standard service. Cache writes cost $12.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272K input tokens, the full request costs 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output rates. Regional processing adds 10%; Batch/Flex and Fast have separate rates.
Standard service. Cache writes cost $2.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272K input tokens, the full request costs 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output rates. Regional processing adds 10%.
Standard service. Cache writes cost $0.125 per 1M tokens. Above 272K input tokens, the full request costs 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output rates. Regional processing adds 10%.

Current promotional standard-tier pricing for Google's most capable Flash model. On January 1, 2027, prices become $1.50 input, $0.15 cached input, and $7.50 output; cache storage also rises from $0.50 to $1.00 per 1M tokens per hour.
Google's current Gemini Developer API pricing page lists Gemma 4 with free input, output, and context caching, while the paid tier remains unavailable.
Public API model. Cache reads cost 2.5% of base input, not the older 10% rate. Cache writes cost $12.50 (5 minutes) or $20 (1 hour) per 1M tokens. US-only inference is 1.1x standard pricing.
Invitation-only Project Glasswing model; not a self-serve offering. Shares Fable 5.1 specifications and pricing. Cache writes cost $12.50 (5 minutes) or $20 (1 hour) per 1M tokens.
Public API model. Cache reads cost 5% of base input. Cache writes cost $5 (5 minutes) or $8 (1 hour) per 1M tokens. US-only inference is 1.1x standard pricing.
Published rates rechecked September 25, 2026. Cache writes cost $2.50 (5 minutes) or $4 (1 hour) per 1M tokens.

Use API ID deepseek-flash; retired V4 Flash aliases now route here. Supports vision, 1M context and up to 384K output. Peak hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday excluding Chinese public holidays. All other times are half-price; charts use peak rates.

API ID deepseek-v4-pro; V4-Pro-0813, 1M context and up to 384K output; no vision support. Peak hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday excluding Chinese public holidays. All other times are half-price; charts use peak rates.

Pay-as-you-go for up to 1M input tokens, both thinking and non-thinking. Other deployment regions have different rates. The cache documentation explicitly excludes Qwen3.8 Max from the generic 10% explicit / 20% implicit cache-hit rules and directs users to the console; no cache price is assumed here.
Together AI's public serverless price for Z AI's GLM-5.3, released August 13, 2026 with a 1M-token context window. These are Together's rates, not Z AI's direct API rates.
Open-weight native multimodal model with a 1,048,576-token context window. Cache writes cost $3 (5-minute TTL) or $6 (1-hour TTL) per 1M tokens, separate from $0.30 cache reads.
Dedicated coding model with a 262,144-token context window. The high-speed variant is $1.90 cache-miss input, $0.38 cache-hit input, and $8.00 output per 1M tokens.

Overseas real-time API pricing; cache writes are temporarily free. Batch is half-price. The separate UltraSpeed variant costs $4.35 input, $0.036 cached input and $8.70 output. MiMo V2.5 Pro and V2.5 retire October 21, 2026 at 10:00 Beijing time.
Overseas real-time API pricing. Batch costs $0.07 input, $0.0014 cached input and $0.14 output per 1M tokens. Cache writes are temporarily free; web search is billed separately.
Global standard-service rates after the published permanent 50% reduction. Above 512K input tokens: $0.60 input, $0.12 cache read and $2.40 output. Priority service costs 1.5x standard rates.

500K context window, but the long-context billing threshold is 200K input tokens. At or above 200K, all tokens in the request cost $4 input, $1 cached input and $12 output per 1M tokens. US regional inference adds 10%.

Copilot combines seat subscriptions with model-dependent GitHub AI Credit usage. There is no single Copilot-model input/output token rate; compare plan allowances below, not N/A values as zero-cost inference.

subscription_pricing.notes: Individual plan. API usage is billed separately.
Pro capabilities with 5x the Plus usage allowance. No annual billing.

20x the Plus usage allowance. New sign-ups and upgrades paused since September 10, 2026; existing subscriptions continue, with a limited one-time return option for eligible former subscribers. No annual billing.
Standard seat includes ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex. At least two Standard/Premium seats combined are required. API usage is separate; workspace credits can extend usage.
5x Standard-seat usage and no 5-hour usage limit. Standard and Premium seats can be mixed; at least two seats combined are required. API usage is separate.
Individual plan; annual billing is equivalent to about $17 per month.
Five times the Pro usage allowance. Includes Claude Code; model-specific limits apply.
Twenty times the Pro usage allowance. Includes Claude Code; model-specific limits apply.
For teams of 2 to 150. Premium seats cost $100 per seat per month billed annually, or $125 per seat per month billed monthly; seat types can be mixed.
Individual plan with 2x Gemini usage limits and 400 GB of storage. Regional prices and storage bundles vary.
Individual plan with 4x Gemini usage limits and 5 TB of storage. Regional prices vary.
Higher-access Ultra tier with 5x the Pro usage limits and 20 TB of storage.
Highest-access Ultra tier with 20x the Pro usage limits and 30 TB of storage.
Fixed-price coding plan for supported Qwen and selected third-party models; request quotas apply.

Lite, Standard and Pro list prices. The launch announcement advertises limited-time $6 / $18 / $68 rates; confirm eligibility and current discounts at checkout. Credits have 5-hour and 7-day windows, separate from pay-as-you-go API billing.
subscription_pricing.source_label: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Token Plan

subscription_pricing.notes: Individual Lite, Standard, Pro and Max developer tiers; includes MiMo V2.6 Pro/Flash. Separate coding-tool quota, not general-purpose API balance or a MiMo Desktop membership price.
Individual Lite, Standard, Pro and Max annual developer plans, billed upfront. Rates reflect the documented annual discount; separate from Desktop membership pricing.
Personal Token Plan with rolling 5-hour and weekly quota windows. Optional prepaid Credits cover overflow and are billed separately.
Personal Token Plan with rolling 5-hour and weekly quota windows. Text, eligible image and speech resources share the quota.
Personal Token Plan for intensive use, with rolling 5-hour and weekly quota windows. Not an unlimited API subscription.

USD prices on the Kimi Code plan page; annual equivalent $15/month. Includes Kimi membership and coding access. New plans have monthly quotas and a rolling 5-hour limit; legacy plans have different rules.
USD prices; annual equivalent $31/month. Kimi Code with K3 up to 1M context and HighSpeed access. API Open Platform billing is separate.
USD prices; annual equivalent $79/month. Higher membership quota, shared with Kimi Code; API Open Platform billing is separate.
USD prices; annual equivalent $159/month. Highest coding-plan quota shown on the public page; API Open Platform billing is separate.
Includes higher Grok limits and SuperGrok; regional prices vary.
Currently $15 monthly AI Credit value: $10 base plus $5 variable Flex allotment. Flex allowances can change.
Currently $70 monthly AI Credit value: $39 base plus $31 variable Flex allotment. Flex allowances can change.
Currently $200 monthly AI Credit value: $100 base plus $100 variable Flex allotment. Flex allowances can change.
Organization-managed plan; 1,900 AI Credits ($19 value) per granted seat per month contribute to a shared pool. Additional usage is billed separately.
For GitHub Enterprise Cloud; 3,900 AI Credits ($39 value) per granted seat per month contribute to a shared pool. Additional usage is billed separately.
